purpose: Test whether a native interventional source-response operator followed by a persistent sensor and transport-marginalized censored reachability evidence gives reproducible source ordering across H01, H02 and H03.

scientific_modules.M1: native GADEN do(S=s) physical concentration followed by the frozen run-persistent sensor operator
scientific_modules.M2: one ever/never event per completed physical stop; predictive transport/placement nuisance is marginalized inside each stop before censored Bernoulli evidence is accumulated across stops

scope.independent_unit: House x reserved observation member; seeds, sources and stops are repeated measurements inside a unit
scope.physical_stop: one maximal contiguous is_moving=0 run; use its first 80 samples and exclude runs shorter than 80 samples

frozen_inputs.schedule_mapping_rule: for every House and seed0..9, the historical OFF sim_pose_trace SHA-256 must equal the same numbered train and reserved stream hash in bank_summary.json

frozen_score.event: E[s,m,r,b] = 1 if max measured_ppm over the first 80 samples of physical stop b is greater than 0.1, else 0
frozen_score.predictive_probability: p[s,r,b] = (0.5 + sum over 8 train members E[s,m,r,b]) / 9
frozen_score.candidate_score: L[s] = sum over physical stops b of E_obs[b] log p[s,b] + (1-E_obs[b]) log(1-p[s,b])
frozen_score.rank: descending exact-equality midrank among all House carriers
frozen_score.likelihood_boundary: a fixed finite-ensemble composite predictive likelihood, not an exact joint likelihood for autocorrelated stops
frozen_score.transport_semantics: no K identity is retained across stops; the run-persistent sensor is applied to the complete chronology before stop events are extracted

first_passage_ablation.role: report-only temporal-resolution ablation; it cannot change the Gate verdict
first_passage_ablation.support: first strict hit sample 0..79 or 80 for right-censored no-hit
first_passage_ablation.predictive_model: symmetric Jeffreys-Dirichlet categorical predictive distribution from the same eight train members
first_passage_ablation.prohibition: a favorable exact-phase result cannot rescue a failed reachability Gate

source_label_null.mapping: one deterministic SHA256-domain-separated non-identity carrier-label permutation per House and replicate, shared across seeds and reserved members

forbidden: changing threshold, stop length, sensor constants, member count or carrier set after reading scores
treating sources, stops or seeds as independent probability units
using PMFS posterior, source truth from historical runs, localization error or planner outcome
retaining a coherent turbulent K across stops
calling exact first-passage phase the main mechanism
calling this fixed-trajectory premise Gate a closed-loop result
downstream: PASS permits a separate measured-only PMFS source-update shadow. Only that shadow plus runtime provider, single-consumption replacement and planner closure can authorize paired 300-s OFF/ON experiments.
